scenarioConfig.name: Rath Yatra Morning, Monsoon Burst, One Siren
scenarioConfig.description: FLAGSHIP multi-event showcase. 09:20 on the real 148th Rath Yatra morning of 27 Jun 2025 (procession stepped off 07:00 from Jamalpur): three chariots crawl Gandhi Road and Relief Road with lakhs on the street, a monsoon burst at 18 mm/h waterlogs the Nehru Bridge approach, bazaar crowds stand behind Swami Vivekananda Road barricades — and a 108 ambulance carrying a cardiac patient requests a green corridor across the river: Relief Road -> Nehru Bridge -> Ashram Road south -> Riverfront West (1005->1015->1001->1006). The engine's answer: closure_policy = signal_hold at 45 s advance — 'regulated, not stopped' — threading a medical convoy between a public festival and the weather.

unit_tracks.note: Recorded agency-unit positions the City Command REPLAY animates (agency_unit frames, a frame every 20 s of tape time). EMULATED units only (EM ids): two Jan Rakshak beats on the yatra roads (Gandhi Road + Relief Road) and the 108 ambulance's green-corridor run, Relief Road -> Nehru Bridge across the river to Income Tax Circle (J2), timed to the emergency_vehicle windows (1005 from 600 s, 1015 from 700 s); the 1006 / 1001 windows hold the cross traffic at J2 as it clears. Its last frame, at J2, is stationary and reports 'arrived' (the C-A spelling of on_scene): the green corridor ends there, and the hospital leg beyond J2 is not recorded. Geometry: the run's segment paths from the store (COALESCE(display_geom, geom)) when it has them, else route_geometry — the same segments as seeded (sample_corridor.sql).
